description: Incremental edit without recompression, append mode (the default): the original bytes stay verbatim, the replaced README.md and the new CHANGELOG.md are appended and a new central directory follows. Fast and byte-preserving — but the superseded README payload REMAINS in the file (data remanence; ZIP_DEAD_BYTES_RATIO fires past 50 % dead bytes). Use mode 'compact' when deletion matters.
